decisions.reason: False positive: definitions need not prove their descriptive titles locally. The actual box is nonempty and convex; lem-pde-box-control-set-basic-properties proves norm closure by the inequalities (q_a-q)^+ <= |q_n-q| and (q-q_b)^+ <= |q_n-q|, whose L2 norms tend to zero. The page uses that proved result, so no unproved closedness premise is introduced.

False positive: 'let Q_ad be the pointwise box of def-pde-box-control-set' fixes an arbitrary box as part of the input data. That linked definition requires ordered L2 bounds; thus Q_ad means Q_ad(q_a,q_b) for such fixed bounds, even though their names are suppressed here. State well-posedness does not depend on the box, and all minimization consumers retain exactly these box hypotheses.

Confirmed nonfatal citation/derivation omission: F1's 'precisely' omitted strict free-coordinate feasibility. The scalar witness H=1,c=0,[0,1] is rejected in free status but retained in lower status, so it does not refute the theorem. F1 now states the exact rule; step 2.1 assigns only strictly interior minimizer coordinates free status, proves the principal block invertible, and shows its unique solve recovers those coordinates. Coincident bounds use a sign-compatible active status; quadratic expansion proves uniqueness.

Confirmed nonfatal indexing defect: 1/n is undefined at the library's natural index zero. Both the Countable Choice family and step 1.1 now use 1/(n+1), with nonemptiness justified by the infimum and a uniform tolerance at most one. The positive-indexed tail matches the weak-subsequence supplier. Weak norm lower semicontinuity, the affine state map, strict convexity, and both directions of the variational inequality remain valid; the Statement is unchanged.

False positive: thm-fem-control-proximal-gradient-residual-distance-bound is the existing separate proved correctness result. Its steps 1.1 and 2.1 use the complete Strang gradient bound and nonexpansive clipped-cell projection to prove the exact residual bound and finite termination. The two finite-return routines explicitly return valid exact outputs or failure; no exact-computation ability is inferred from boundedness of B. The compressed Hessian argument also correctly uses the restricted L_h bound. No algorithm edit is needed.

Confirmed nonfatal dependency overstatement: the clipped-adjoint corollary gives necessity for an existing optimum, not the sufficiency claimed by F2. The existing existence/VI theorem supplies sufficiency directly: B*p_*=p_* and p_*+q_*=0, so the VI is zero for every feasible comparison. Replaced the citation and dependency accordingly. Also made the necessary fixed load f=0 and E=Omega explicit; the weak state/adjoint identities, coercivity, bounded load operator, and 0<=q_*<=1/2 are verified. No new supplier is needed.

Confirmed nonfatal interface/citation imprecision: the exact-Newton Definition requires nonsingularity, whereas QR needs independent active rows and positive Lagrangian curvature on their null space. These checks were named but not specified there. Step 1 now explicitly verifies both conditions, cites the QR Definition that actually requires them, and fails when either cannot be verified. The successful status is explicitly a linearized KKT residual; nonlinear equalities remain allowed and need a separate next-point check. No local convergence or global feasibility claim is added.

Confirmed nonfatal title omission: the valid conditional Statement assumes full uniform O(h^2) state/adjoint L2 estimates, including all defects, in addition to H2 regularity and dual approximation. The title now includes that indispensable condition. Adjoint consistency gives g_h-g=p_h-p; continuous and discrete VIs and alpha-strong monotonicity yield alpha||e||^2<=C h^2||e||, with e=0 handled before division. No rate is inferred merely from an energy estimate. Statement, proof, and page remain unchanged.

Confirmed fatal logic defect in the original next-point claim: affine box constraints do not make F_A affine when nonlinear equalities are allowed. For phi(x)=x^2/2, h(x)=x^2-1, inactive box [-3,3], z=(2,0), K=[[1,4],[4,0]], the step s=(-3/4,-5/16) has zero linear residual, but F_A(z+s)=(15/32,9/16). The repaired affine branch explicitly requires all equalities and active inequalities affine and derives the block identity directly. The universal intended-linear-system certificate and the separate conditional exact-Newton convergence conclusion are preserved.
